name: Saturn V S-IVB (AS-506)
about: Apollo 11's third stage after the spacecraft left it: the slingshot past the Moon into orbit about the Sun.

pieces.why: after the evasive burn (4:40:01) and slingshot burns (LOX dump, APS 5:37:47); closest to the Moon at 78:42
the slingshot leaves it in orbit about the Sun; its elements are not on record here yet
